description: This PHP class 'Antispam' provides methods for managing anti-spam keyword records in a database, including adding, editing, deleting, and querying records. It is part of an OpenCart module under the 'Admin/Model/Cms' namespace.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: A model class for managing anti-spam keywords within the OpenCart admin panel. Implements CRUD operations for antispam records.

methods.name: addAntispam
methods.description: Creates a new antispam record in the database with the provided keyword.

methods.name: editAntispam
methods.description: Updates an existing antispam record identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAntispam
methods.description: Removes an antispam record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getAntispam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific antispam record by ID.

methods.name: getAntispams
methods.description: Fetches a list of antispam records, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalAntispams
methods.description: Returns the total count of antispam records, optionally filtered by keyword.
